fusions.name: Toyed With
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: a raking swipe that deals 18 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unseen Spring
fusions.desc: A sprung strike that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Stalking Crouch
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and you move 11% faster; enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lands Right
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
